【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Though biofilms were first described by Antonie van Leeuwenhoek, the theory describing the biofilm process was not developed until 1978.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Biofilms: survival mechanisms of clinically relevant microorganisms》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Current intervention strategies are designed to prevent initial device colonization, minimize microbial cell attachment to the device, penetrate the biofilm matrix and kill the associated cells, or remove the device from the patient.
